skill.description: Research Douyin topics, current rankings, and competitor content through SocialDataX keyword search and hot-search tools.

skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: One finding confirms execution of an unpinned npm package with the service API key available, creating a supply-chain exposure. The remaining 62 findings concern Markdown syntax, intended authentication, service links, or readable Chinese text rather than demonstrated threats. No evidence found of prompt injection or intentional credential exfiltration; the external package implementation was not included for review.

remediation.issue: The direct CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y with access to the service credential.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and integrity through a lockfile; obtain execution approval and isolate the runtime from unrelated credentials.

content.user_title: Research Douyin Topics and Content Samples
content.value_statement: Douyin content planning needs current signals and traceable examples, not unsupported trend claims. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and organizes rankings, content samples, and evidence-based observations.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the current Douyin hot-search list through the documented SocialDataX CLI or corresponding MCP tool.
Search Douyin content by keyword with sorting, publication-time, duration, and content-type filters.
Collect bounded search samples using page limits, item limits, and opaque continuation tokens.
Organize returned titles, authors, links, content IDs, metrics, and publication times when available.
Separate current rankings, search samples, visible evidence, and analytical judgments.
Preserve partial results and resume eligible searches without exceeding the original collection limits.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance; the CLI also requires Node.js and npm.
The skill contains instructions, not the external CLI implementation; its examples execute an unpinned npm package.
Search results are bounded samples, not exhaustive coverage or proof of historical trends.
The documented workflow does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify accounts; returned fields can vary.

use_cases.title: Select creator topics
use_cases.description: Review current hot-search signals and related content samples to identify relevant topics and follow-up questions.

use_cases.title: Compare competitor content
use_cases.description: Search brand or account keywords with consistent filters and compare returned titles, formats, and engagement indicators.

use_cases.title: Prepare an editorial evidence brief
use_cases.description: Collect a bounded sample, preserve source references, and separate observations from recommendations for an editorial meeting.

prompt_templates.title: Review current rankings
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the current Douyin hot-search list. Summarize relevant topics and returned heat signals without claiming historical growth.

prompt_templates.title: Find a focused sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Douyin for [topic] from the past week. Retrieve one page of videos under one minute. Preserve available titles, authors, and links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: collect a small filtered sample.

prompt_templates.title: Compare brand samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [brand A] and [brand B] using past-week video searches sorted by likes. Limit each sample to 20 items. Separate evidence from interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a bounded research brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] using current hot-search signals and at most three search pages or 50 items, whichever comes first. Keep rankings separate from samples. Preserve references, label partial results, and propose three supported content angles.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine sources while enforcing collection limits.

output_examples.input: Show an example brief structure for current hot-search topics and related samples.
output: Illustrative format only; no live data was retrieved.
Current rankings: list returned topics, ranks, and available heat signals.
Related search samples: list titles, authors, and available source references separately.
Interpretation: explain relevance and identify questions that need more evidence.

output_examples.input: Show an example status note when a bounded search returns partial results.
output: Illustrative format only; no live query was performed.
Status: results are incomplete; retained samples remain available for review.
Evidence: preserve collected references and the reported error.
Recovery: resolve the error and continue only with a valid returned token and remaining limits.
Boundary: do not restart automatically when no continuation token is available.

best_practices: Start with one page and explicit item limits; increase collection only when the research question needs more evidence.
Use a reviewed, pinned CLI version and keep the API key in the environment rather than prompts or shared reports.
Preserve available source references and filters; distinguish rankings, search samples, and interpretations.
anti_patterns: Treating a current ranking or a small search sample as proof of sustained platform-wide growth.
Restarting partial searches from the first page or altering opaque pagination tokens.
Sharing API keys in prompts or repeatedly retrying insufficient-balance errors.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: You need SocialDataX credentials, sufficient service balance, and network access. Direct CLI use also needs Node.js and npm.

faq.question: Can I use MCP instead of the CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents corresponding hot-search and keyword-search MCP tools when those tools are already available.

faq.question: Does it change my Douyin account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only and excludes login, publishing, likes, comments, and account changes. The external package implementation was not reviewed here.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every matching result?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable complete-result boundary. Use page and item limits, and continue only with returned pagination tokens.

faq.question: What happens when a request fails?
faq.answer: Preserve partial results and error details. Resolve the error before continuing with a valid token and remaining limits. Avoid repeated insufficient-balance retries.

faq.question: Are the marketplace output examples live results?
faq.answer: No. They show illustrative report structures. Actual topics, fields, links, and metrics depend on service responses.
